ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to restrict hospitalization cost products to the matching product year.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Data_Migration_Check__c.Bypass_Flow_Validations__c = FALSE, RecordType.Name = 'Hospitalization', !ISBLANK(Service_Provided_by_Facility__c), !ISBLANK(Date_of_Admission__c), OR( AND( MONTH(Date_of_Admission__c) < 4 , !CONTAINS(Service_Provided_by_Facility__r.Name, TEXT(YEAR(Date_of_Admission__c))) ), AND( MONTH(Date_of_Admission__c) > 3 , !CONTAINS(Service_Provided_by_Facility__r.Name, TEXT(YEAR(Date_of_Admission__c) + 1)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The product must match product year for hospitalization costs.
